title: Social Geography & Population Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of Indian demographics, census 2011 data, and tribal groups.

questions.question: What percentage of the world's total population does India represent according to the 2011 Census?

Which Union Territory recorded the highest decadal population growth rate (55.50%) in 2001-2011?
The 'Sentinelese' and 'Jarawas' are indigenous tribes of which region?
Which tribe is primarily associated with the Nilgiri Hills in Tamil Nadu?
What is the Child Sex Ratio of Tamil Nadu according to the 2011 Census?
Which is the largest district in Tamil Nadu in terms of geographical area?
Which district in Tamil Nadu has the highest literacy rate?
Which district in Tamil Nadu records the lowest sex ratio?
The 'Bakkarwals' and 'Gujjars' of J&K and Himachal Pradesh are primarily known for which occupation?
